verified.description:
`true` when every gate in IReadOnlyList<VerificationGateView> RunVerificationView.Gates is
`passed` AND at least one gate has been evaluated — the run's
verification axis is fully terminal and positive. A run with no
gates yet, with mixed `passed`/`pending`, or with any
`failed` is `false`.

verificationPending.description:
`true` when at least one gate is still `pending`
AND the run is not yet fully verified — the "verification pending"
annotation the spec introduces. Terminal failures do NOT count as
pending: a run with one `pending` and one `failed` gate
is `pending=true`; a run with only `failed` is
`pending=false`.

evidenceRefs.description: Evidence URIs the provider stamped; empty when the verdict is `Pending`.

evaluatedAt.description: UTC stamp the provider returned; matches the record's `evaluated_at`.

evaluator.description: Provider-defined evaluator string (operator name, model id, or `"system"`).

items.description:
Per-gate wire shape for `GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/verification`.
The verdict string is the lower-case `GateVerdict` smart-type
name (`pending` / `passed` / `failed`); the evidence URI
is returned as a plain string so the FE can resolve it through the
existing artifact endpoint without the engine re-encoding the URL.

gates.description: One entry per evaluated (work item, gate) pair. Newest first within a work item.

description:
Run-level wire shape for `GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/verification`
(add-orchestra §3 — Coda, `verification/spec.md` Requirement
"Verification view is a derived read"). The two top-level booleans
surface the "verification pending" annotation the FE renders as a
pill under the run's status strip; the per-gate list renders as the
evidence drill-down beneath it. The semantics are derived from the
IReadOnlyList<VerificationGateView> RunVerificationView.Gates list alone — a future per-project
`VerifyEnabled` read is gated on the registry returning at
least one record (the project is provably opted in if a provider
has stamped anything).
